lines: “能够死在我的床榻之上，也算是你的造化了！我答应你的，自然会兑现！”
迷迷糊糊之间，一个清冷的声音在陈玄的耳畔响起。
陈玄很疲惫，他感觉自己腰仿佛要断了。
疲惫感让他睁不开眼睛，他下意识的四下抓了抓，一股惊人的弹性传来。
“你没死？”
这个时候，那个清冷的声音又是响了起来。
陈玄竭尽全力睁开了眼睛，入眼是一张近乎完美的脸蛋，她看起来三十岁上下，肌肤若凝，前凸后翘。
最为关键的是，她那完美的身姿，就这么毫无保留，淋漓尽致的展现在了陈玄的面前，陈玄的手，正搭在了她的心口，那惊人的触感给陈玄带来了一种前所未有的快感。
“有趣！”这女人看着陈玄，脸上并没有慌乱，也没有丝毫的娇羞，取而代之的，是一种饶有兴致之色。
“你一个普通人，与我双修，居然还能够捡回来一条命！”女人看着陈玄道：“看来，你倒是一个不错的炉鼎，好生修养，三日后，我会安排人让你再来我这里！”
女人说着，她便站起身来。
在陈玄失望的目光之中，那女人的身上，凭空出现了一身衣衫，将她那完美的身姿给掩盖了起来。
她淡淡的说道：“待会儿会有人把你送回去，承诺给你的，你既然活着，便一分不会少给你！我先给你二十两纹银，这三天，去买些东西，好生补补！”
说完女人便朝着门外走去，走了几步，她再度停了下来道：“昨夜之事，若是你敢对外宣称半个字，后果你应该清楚！”
看着消失的女人，陈玄挣扎着从床上坐了起来。
他面前的床单，一片的浇湿，可想而知昨天晚上到底有多么的疯狂。
“是在做梦吗？”
陈玄喃喃的开口。
就在此时，他只觉得脑袋一阵的疼痛，同时…一股记忆，瞬间席卷而来。
强烈的冲击，让他本就虚弱的身体再也坚持不住，他两眼一黑，直接昏厥了过去。
当陈玄再度醒来的时候，已经是下午了。
他猛然坐了起来，入眼不再是那宽大的床，而是一片堆满了杂物的房间。
他的手里，还攥着两锭纹银！
“我…穿越了？”陈玄呆呆的看着眼前陌生的环境。
是的，他穿越了，他本是一名特种兵，在中东执行作战任务的时候，中弹昏迷。
当他醒过来的时候，就穿越到了这个和他同名同姓的陈玄身上。
陈玄本是京都乡下一个农民的孩子，今年十六岁。
一个月以前，将军府招纳下人，他哥哥和将军府的厨子认识，托了这层关系，把他送到了将军府，成为了一个帮厨。
而这将军府，则是大周王朝镇国大将军秦烨的府邸。
秦烨膝下无子，三年前，他战死南疆，只留下了将军府的六名夫人和三个女儿！
昨夜，大夫人林婉的贴身侍女，将全府所有男丁全部召集了起来，最后陈玄因为容貌清秀，被挑选了出来，送到了大夫人林婉的床榻之上！
林婉告知陈玄，说需要陈玄和她双修，双修之后，陈玄今晚可能会死，但是他会在享受和幸福之中死去，并且如果死了，林婉会给他家里纹银百两！
于是，陈玄同意了！
他命贱，如果能够用命换取百两纹银，也算对得起自己的父母。

"Being able to die on my bed is your blessing! I will certainly honor what I promised you!"
In a daze, a cold voice sounded in Chen Xuan's ears.
Chen Xuan was very tired, and he felt as if his waist was about to break.
Fatigue prevented him from opening his eyes. He subconsciously scratched around and felt an astonishing elasticity.
"You're not dead?"
At this time, the cold voice sounded again.
Chen Xuan tried his best to open his eyes, and what he saw was an almost perfect face. She looked about thirty years old, with condensed skin and bulging front and back.
The most important thing is that her perfect figure was displayed in front of Chen Xuan without any reservation. Chen Xuan's hand was placed on her heart. The amazing touch brought Chen Xuan an unprecedented pleasure.
"Interesting!" The woman looked at Chen Xuan. There was no panic or shyness on her face. Instead, there was a look of interest.
"You, an ordinary person, can still save a life by cultivating with me!" The woman looked at Chen Xuan and said: "It seems that you are a good furnace and you are well-educated. In three days, I will arrange for you to come to my place again!"
The woman said as she stood up.
In Chen Xuan's disappointed eyes, a piece of clothing appeared out of thin air on the woman's body, covering up her perfect figure.
She said calmly: "Someone will send you back later. Since you are alive, I will not give you any less of what I promised you! I will give you twenty taels of silver first. In the next three days, go buy some things to replenish your health!"
After saying that, the woman walked towards the door. After walking a few steps, she stopped again and said, "If you dare to tell anyone about what happened last night, you should know the consequences!"
Looking at the disappearing woman, Chen Xuan struggled to sit up from the bed.
The sheets in front of him were all wet, and you could imagine how crazy he was last night.
"Are you dreaming?"
Chen Xuan murmured.
At this moment, he only felt a pain in his head, and at the same time...a wave of memory swept over him instantly.
The strong impact made his already weak body unable to hold on any longer. His eyes darkened and he fainted.
…
When Chen Xuan woke up again, it was already afternoon.
He suddenly sat up, and what he saw was no longer the large bed, but a room filled with clutter.
In his hand, he still held two ingots of grained silver!
"I... traveled through time?" Chen Xuan stared blankly at the unfamiliar environment in front of him.
Yes, he traveled through time. He was a special forces soldier who was shot and fell into coma while performing a combat mission in the Middle East.
When he woke up, he was in the body of Chen Xuan, who had the same name and surname as him.
Chen Xuanben is the child of a farmer in the countryside of Kyoto. He is sixteen years old this year.
A month ago, the General's Mansion was recruiting servants. His brother knew the cook of the General's Mansion, and with the help of this relationship, he was sent to the General's Mansion to become a cook.
The General's Mansion is the residence of Qin Ye, the great general of the Zhou Dynasty.
Qin Ye had no children. Three years ago, he died in the battle in Southern Xinjiang, leaving only six wives and three daughters in the general's mansion!
Last night, the personal maid of the eldest lady Lin Wan summoned all the men in the house. Finally, Chen Xuan was selected because of his handsome appearance and was sent to the bed of the eldest lady Lin Wan!
Lin Wan told Chen Xuan that she needed Chen Xuan to practice double cultivation with her. After the double cultivation, Chen Xuan might die tonight, but he would die in enjoyment and happiness, and if he died, Lin Wan would give him a hundred taels of silver tattoo on his home!
So, Chen Xuan agreed!
He has a cheap life. If he can exchange his life for a hundred taels of silver, he can be considered worthy of his parents.
